result.summary: The image shows a typical urban intersection with sidewalks, pedestrian signals, and marked crosswalks. While basic infrastructure is present, the crosswalk markings are significantly faded, and the wide street geometry may encourage higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk lines are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for relatively high-speed vehicle turns into the crosswalk area.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style high-visibility crosswalk markings to improve driver awareness of the pedestrian crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by wide sidewalks in a dense commercial area, but lacks critical safety markings and signals at the intersection. While traffic lights are present, the absence of marked crosswalks and pedestrian-specific signals increases risk for those crossing the street.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: No painted markings define the pedestrian crossing area at this signalized intersection.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: Pedestrians must rely on vehicle signals, which may not provide sufficient time or clear indication for crossing.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked and stopped vehicles near the intersection corners block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly delineate pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to improve safety and predictability.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility at the intersection.

result.summary: The image depicts a dense urban commercial corridor with wide sidewalks and a bus stop. While the street is relatively narrow, there is a lack of marked crosswalks in the immediate foreground where pedestrians are present, and existing pavement markings are significantly faded.

hazards.name: Unmarked crossing point
hazards.description: Pedestrians are positioned at the curb in an area with high foot traffic but no visible marked crosswalk, increasing the risk of unpredictable crossings.

hazards.name: Faded pavement markings
hazards.description: Lane lines and stop bars are heavily worn, which can lead to driver confusion and poor lane discipline.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility zebra or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly delineate pedestrian crossing areas.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance for pedestrians and improve visibility between drivers and people waiting to cross.

interventions.title: Pavement Marking Refresh
interventions.description: Repaint all lane lines and stop bars to improve driver awareness and organization of the roadway.

result.summary: The image shows a typical urban mixed-use street with sidewalks on both sides but lacks marked pedestrian crossings at the visible intersection. Pedestrians are seen crossing the street at an unmarked corner, highlighting a gap in formal infrastructure despite the presence of a bus stop and commercial activity.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Lack of marked crosswalks at an intersection with pedestrian activity and a bus stop increases the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflict.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection area where the pedestrian is crossing

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb may obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers, especially near the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street along the curb

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Visible cracking and wear in the roadway surface can affect vehicle braking and create tripping hazards.
